status: C2a native investigation/probe implementation and CPU-qualified diagnostic protocol for review; production engine and fork unchanged

protocol.numerical_publication: two preallocated four-f64 slots plus one i32 selector per record
protocol.consume: at entry before acquiring child inputs
protocol.publish: complete inactive slot, then native atomic_xor(selector,1), then native parent activation
protocol.lifetimes: single writer/at most one publication per record per poll; no overlap between polls or structural writers; all current readers complete before the next poll can reuse a slot
protocol.kernel_atomic_qualification: compiled Program-retained LLVM module must preserve SC selector RMW sites; source atomic request alone is insufficient

limits: Diagnostic packets propagate a maximum tag; this is publication/notification evidence, not centroid arithmetic, inherited response or physics-settling qualification.
Production engine/runtime/fork, source graph, tick order and numerical laws are unchanged. No hierarchy installation or new public binding API.
Numerical slot selector addresses published data and never selects work. No second awake set, scheduling epoch, custom queue, spin or host/per-depth solver.
One-publisher/one-visit-per-poll and dispatch-completion lifetime bounds are essential; arbitrary overlapping writers/polls are unsupported.

Audit inspects the compiled module retained by Program before launcher JIT executable copying. Native CPU execution is separate evidence; future compiler/kernel-shape/backend changes must requalify ordering.
Workers are configured explicitly as one/two native CPU workers; deterministic negative controls cover harmful orders independently of stress interleavings.
Typed payload excludes fixed containers, caller graph fixtures, LLVM/JIT/runtime structures, native roots, pool alignment and physical residency. Known native backing is measured separately.
Linked C++ new/new[] observations exclude arbitrary malloc, page residency/faults and driver internals. Host vectors are ordinary unpinned memory.
Case elapsed time includes both publications, resets/seeding, inspection and assertions; poll kernel and inspection timing/transfer bytes are separately reported. Setup excludes Runtime construction.

No CUDA/GPU qualification or database work. Comparison ownership, complete live hierarchy integration, local/inherited response, coupled settling/recovery, #156 operation exit and #145 GPU work remain open.
